title: Breaking the Generative Steganography Trilemma: ANStega for Optimal Capacity, Efficiency, and Security
why: Near-entropy streaming ANS with cryptographic masking and low coding overhead. Particularly relevant to our size target: reports 3.69 bits/token on Qwen2.5-3B and 4.67 on Phi-2 2.7B in its full-vocabulary experiments.
caveat: The decoder consumes the embedder's final ANS state. Transporting or reconstructing that state must be accounted for before treating this as a self-contained cover-text protocol. Numerical compatibility remains necessary.
